from typing import List, Dict, Any

# Retrieve cached hotel results
cached_hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Retrieve cached attraction results
cached_attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Filter hotels based on gym and wifi requirements
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=cached_hotels,
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for restaurants in San Jose
restaurants_results = search_restaurants(
    city="San Jose"
)

# Save restaurant results to cache
save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants_results)

# Search for attractions in San Jose with the specified type and name
attractions_results = search_attractions(
    city="San Jose",
    type=["Culinary"],
    attraction_name=["Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum"]
)

# Save attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions_results", value=attractions_results)

# Find the nearest hotels to the Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum
nearest_hotels = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions_results,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save the nearest hotels results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels", value=nearest_hotels)

# Print the final results
print("Filtered hotels with gym and wifi:")
print(filtered_hotels.search_results)

print("\nAttractions in San Jose:")
print(attractions_results.search_results)
